name: Last slice
summary: A reaction duel for the last slice of pizza: the box lid lifts, the slice sits under a heat lamp, and at a moment the server picks it glows. First tap after the glow wins it with a cheese pull to their face; tapping early burns your fingers and you're out.
useWhen: one slice left and three people claiming it: 'i paid', 'it's literally mine'
fight over the last dumpling / last cookie / last beer
settle who gets the last of something with a quick game
dibs war in the group chat over leftovers
who gets the last one, fastest finger
dontUseWhen: ordering more food (use late-cart or pizza)
a fair random pick with no skill (use a coin flip or wheel)

shop.description: Where it's from, printed on the box lid, e.g. 'Rook's'

claims.description: Up to 3 people who claimed it in the chat, each with their own line ('i paid')
